confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge and the supplied comparables; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Beer, coffee and meal anchors are more reliable than accommodation anchors, which vary widely in Vientiane room quality and are sensitive to currency volatility. Cocktail and wine were not directly calibrated and are set at roughly 3x the draught-beer anchor. The FX value comes from search-result summaries that cite the RBA exchange-rates page; the page and F11.1 table were not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Anchored to the supplied Siem Reap, Chiang Mai and Phuket observations. Vientiane sits near Siem Reap on beer, budget meals and hostel beds, and below Chiang Mai and Phuket on most lines. Cocktail and wine are derived from the beer anchor (about 3x).
